description: View team members and access levels in projects or groups. Actions: list_project, list_group, get_project, get_group (direct members), list_all_project, list_all_group (includes inherited). Levels: Guest(10), Reporter(20), Developer(30), Maintainer(40), Owner(50). Related: manage_member to add/remove, browse_users to find users by name.

action.description: Action to perform: list_project, list_group, get_project, get_group, list_all_project, list_all_group

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path Required for 'list_group', 'get_group', 'list_all_group' action(s).

include_inherited.description: Include members inherited from parent groups Required for 'get_project', 'get_group' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list_project', 'list_group', 'list_all_project', 'list_all_group' action(s).

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path Required for 'list_project', 'get_project', 'list_all_project' action(s).

query.description: Search members by name or username Required for 'list_project', 'list_group', 'list_all_project', 'list_all_group' action(s).

state.description: Filter by member state Required for 'list_all_project', 'list_all_group' action(s).

user_id.description: User ID of the member Required for 'get_project', 'get_group' action(s).

user_ids.description: Filter to specific user IDs Required for 'list_project', 'list_group', 'list_all_project', 'list_all_group' action(s).

name: browse_members
